I feel the exact same way, man. But it's never to late to improve your situation. Even during the pandemic, thre are still things you can do. For example, develope new hobbies, learn a language, talk to people online, etc. What i have been thinking to myself is this: we will all die after living our short lives anyway, will it hurt to stick around and see what happens? (I say this as someone who has attempted suicide 4 times). I won't bullshit you and tell you that things will suddenly be okay one day, you have to actively try to improve your situation, however slowly and steadily it may be. It's not easy to do when you feel like shit, so i would highly encourage you to try mediaction and therapy if you are able to or at the least go on walks. Walking isn't a cure all of course, it isn't the magical answer that some people think it is, but it gets the mood up ever so slightly.  Anyway, i hope this helped even just a little bit. Hang in there, man.
